business_summary: Longhorn Auto Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and sale of automotive intelligent driving perception systems in China and internationally. The company engages in development and sales of automotive electronic products and related software and systems; technology development and sales of reversing radar, tire pressure gauges, molds, HUD, portable TVs, electronic rearview mirror systems, electronic stability systems, in-vehicle multimedia, and collision avoidance radar; provision of automotive system design and technical services; technology development, and sales of bluetooth products, black boxes, GPS navigation systems, and in-vehicle entertainment system; power supplies, inverters, 360-degree surround view and active safety driving systems, and automatic parking systems; import and export of goods and technology; and manufacturing and sales of intelligent in-vehicle equipment. It is also involved in manufacturing of automotive parts and accessories; development of artificial intelligence theory and algorithms software; software development; digital video surveillance systems; sales of electrical accessories for new energy vehicles; manufacturing of integrated circuit chips and products; security system monitoring services; and tablet computers, wireless telecommunications products, global positioning navigation system products, and mobile communication terminals. In addition, it provides domain controller systems; millimeter-wave radar systems; and visual sensor systems. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
